concepts.reader_question: How do scope, source and confirmation support discussion?
concepts.description: Create one square native PNG minimum1080px; native1254 intended. INTERNAL DIRECTIONS ARE NOT PRINTED TEXT. All background papers/records blank, no microglyphs/dates/charts/record labels/fabricated metrics. Only exact approved artwork text/labels and official mark. Accepted B hierarchy: headline and full body above reduced Fabless planning/photo scene; exact source once AFTER scene as full-width main paragraph, SAME SIZE OR LARGER than body, comfortable nozoom317–333px. Generous wrap/spacing; reduce photo before font; CTA separate bottom row. No skyline/icon column/footer, reference words or extra regional/diagram labels.

calls.prompt:
Create the approved carousel artwork. Use only approved artwork text for printed wording.
References supply only their declared attributes; never copy reference wording, record data or composition.
Campaign visual references guide only reviewed material depth, typography/header identity and scene-integrated diagrams.
Palette/lighting references supply only their declared colors, lighting and shadows.
Never copy reference words, record data, exact composition or mandatory props.
CLOSING STRUCTURAL GUIDE
The independently reviewed closing_layout reference is an exception only for declared structural hierarchy: source full width, source/body hierarchy and CTA separation.
Do not transfer its wording, data, objects, fixed counts or exact photographic composition. Use cohort-appropriate grounded scenes and integrated diagrams.
Print only approved words, source once, no added punctuation or diagram labels. Source must be at least body-sized and comfortable without zoom at ordinary 333px display, full width, never a footnote.
No skyline or icon column may narrow the source. Reduce photo/diagram area before reducing type; keep CTA separate.
